title: Keystone v. Xerox — a promised negotiation process
shortTitle: Keystone v. Xerox — a promised negotiation process
summary: An agreement about how to negotiate differs from a promise to complete the ultimate deal.
notes:
Casebook discussion of a shorter authority.

The notes distinguish breach of a promised process from mere failure to reach final agreement. The scope and enforceability of the actual preliminary undertaking must be identified before assigning expectation of the ultimate transaction.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 189–191. Open assigned page 189.
